entries.title: Psalms 141:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David.> Lord, I have made my cry to you; come to me quickly; give ear to my voice, when it goes up to you.

entries.title: Psalms 141:2
segments: Let my prayer be ordered before you like a sweet smell; and let the lifting up of my hands be like the evening offering.

entries.title: Psalms 141:3
segments: O Lord, keep a watch over my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 141:4
segments: Keep my heart from desiring any evil thing, or from taking part in the sins of the evil-doers with men who do wrong: and let me have no part in their good things.

entries.title: Psalms 141:5
segments: ¶Let the upright give me punishment; and let the god-fearing man put me in the right way; but I will not let the oil of sinners come on my head: when they do evil I will give myself to prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 141:6
segments: When destruction comes to their judges by the side of the rock, they will give ear to my words, for they are sweet.

entries.title: Psalms 141:7
segments: Our bones are broken up at the mouth of the underworld, as the earth is broken by the plough.

entries.title: Psalms 141:8
segments: But my eyes are turned to you, O Lord God: my hope is in you; let not my soul be given up to death.

entries.title: Psalms 141:9
segments: Keep me from the net which they have put down for me, and from the designs of the workers of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 141:10
segments: Let the sinners be taken in the nets which they themselves have put down, while I go free.
